messages:
kevin: Heads-up — started seeing an uptick in partial WS frames for prod-streaming around 11:40 PST. User sessions report truncated messages + some disconnects. Where do folks usually look for the combined logs/metrics/traces for this? @eng-oncall ?

alert-bot: :warning: Alert triggered: `ws.partial_frame_rate` > 5% on cluster prod-stream-3 for 6m. Alert id: ALRT-9234. Link: https://alerts.internal/redwood/ALRT-9234

maria: Short answers: Grafana for per-route chunk timing (panel: streaming/ws_chunk_emit_ms_p50_p95), Datadog logs for message-level partial_frame flags, and Tempo/Jaeger for traces. Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/streaming/ws-overview and https://dd.internal/logs/app?query=partial_frame

jonathan: For quick log filter in Datadog try: `service:streaming AND env:prod AND "partial_frame":true` — then group by `route` and `session_id`. Also check `ws_disconnect_count` and `ws_conn_duration` metrics around the spike window. Example query for metrics explorer: `avg:streaming.ws_chunk_emit_ms{env:prod,route:*}.rollup(avg, 60)`

anna: Traces: search for span name `ws_send_chunk` and filter spans where tag `chunk_bytes < CHUNK_THRESHOLD` or where `chunk_emit_ms > 150`. If you find a sample trace, look for downstream backpressure spans (kafka/ingest) or any `write` timeouts. Sample trace link pattern: https://traces.redwood.company/trace/<TRACE_ID> — paste TRACE_ID here and I can open it.

kevin: Great, thanks. I pulled the logs for 11:38-11:52 and saw `partial_frame=true` ~6.3% with a cluster-side bump in `chunk_emit_ms_p95` to ~320ms. Posted a couple example log lines:

```
# example log
{"ts":"2026-02-12T11:42:13Z","service":"streaming","route":"/v1/chat/stream","session_id":"s-9a3f","event":"send_chunk","chunk_bytes":128,"chunk_emit_ms":328,"partial_frame":true}
```

jonathan: That chunk_emit_ms_p95 jump matches a short GC + network blip we saw on node pm-3. I pulled a trace: https://traces.redwood.company/trace/1a2b3c4d — shows `ws_send_chunk` blocked on `write_socket` for ~290ms then partial frame flagged.

maria: For next steps on observability: 1) increase trace sampling for `ws_send_chunk` on prod for the next 30m so we get more examples, 2) add a Grafana panel to show `partial_frame_rate` by `route` and `node`, 3) consider alert tune (currently instantaneous >5%).

kevin: On tuning — proposal: only alert when `partial_frame_rate > 5%` AND `chunk_emit_ms_p95 > 200ms` sustained for 10m OR if `ws_disconnect_count` > 1/min for 5m. Thoughts?

anna: I like that. Reduces noise from small one-off spikes. Also add a runbook link to the alert with quick checks (traces, node health, recent deploys).

maria: I'll open a PR for the alert rule change and add the runbook. Assigning to @jonathan for review. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/observability/pulls/482 :thumbsup:

kevin: Thanks — I'll keep monitoring and paste any trace ids I find. If it keeps happening I'll escalate to infra. :eyes:
